judged_text: The isTeamAdminOrOwner authorization check joins the two role queries with `&&` instead of `||`, requiring the caller to be both team admin and team owner when the variable name and intent are either-or. A team ADMIN who is not the OWNER is rejected with FORBIDDEN when adding guests to team bookings (and depending on isTeamAdmin's role matching, even owners can fail both prongs), so the authorization check does not implement its stated policy — fail-closed, so no exposure, but the feature is silently broken for a whole role and the next editor who 'fixes' the operator to `||` will be changing live authorization logic without any test having pinned the intended semantics.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the caller to be both admin and owner. Given the variable name and subsequent authorization gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)`, a team admin (but not owner) will be incorrectly rejected with `FORBIDDEN` when adding guests to team bookings.
